run_spacerunner_command: run a script on Hugging Face Spaces backend using the spacerunner CLI subcommand
register_spacerunner_subcommand: register the spacerunner subcommand with an argparse parser for AutoTrain CLI
create_dataset_repo_from_script: create a Hugging Face dataset repository from a script path and project name
parse_env_and_args: parse semicolon-delimited environment variables and script arguments into dictionaries
launch_spacerunner_job: launch a SpaceRunner job with GenericParams and log the returned job ID
